zh: 只能加 1，所以先算每个位置还差多少：d[i]=target[i]−source[i]；前缀操作给左边若干位置加 1，后缀操作给右边若干位置加 1。
若 d[i]>d[i+1]，这个下降只能靠恰好止于 i 的前缀操作来补，至少需要 d[i]−d[i+1] 次，而每次前缀操作都会给 d[0] 计入 1。设所有下降之和为 D，则必须 d[0]≥D；满足时剩余需求可以用后缀操作补齐。
计算 d 和 D=Σmax(0, d[i]−d[i+1])；若 d[0]<D 输出 −1，否则输出 d[n−1]+D。全程使用 64 位整数。
en: Only +1 is allowed, so first compute how much each position still needs: d[i] = target[i] - source[i]; a prefix operation adds 1 to some left part and a suffix operation to some right part.

If d[i] > d[i+1], that drop can only be covered by prefix operations ending exactly at i, at least d[i] - d[i+1] of them, and every prefix operation also counts toward d[0]. With D the sum of all drops, d[0] >= D is necessary; when it holds, the remaining demand can be completed by suffix operations.
Compute d and D = sum of max(0, d[i] - d[i+1]); print -1 if d[0] < D, otherwise print d[n-1] + D. Use 64-bit integers throughout.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let d = target - source and let D be the sum of all adjacent drops. If d[0] < D there is no solution; otherwise the answer is d[n-1] + D.

## Proof of correctness

Each adjacent drop d[i] - d[i+1] > 0 can only be produced by prefix operations that end at i, so at least D such operations are needed, and every one of them also adds to the first element; hence d[0] >= D is necessary. After placing prefixes for all drops, the remaining demand is non-negative and non-decreasing, and suffix operations can supply it by its increments; the total count is D + d[n-1]. Using any extra prefixes and suffixes that cancel each other only increases the count, so the lower bound is attained.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
